Cluster 2 ECs (tumor core EC type I: Co1) resembled endothelial angiogenic phenotypes as they have been mapped in both developmental and tumor angiogenesis, and included for example a gene signature associated with vascular basement membrane remodeling ( COL4A1 , COL4A2 , LAMB1 , LAMA4 , HSPG2 , PXDN , PLOD1 , NID1 , NID2 ), cytoskeletal rearrangements ( CD93 , MYO1B , SPARC , INSR ), angiogenic sprouting ( KDR , PGF , ANGPT2 , NOX4 , PTP4A3 , FLT4 ), and endothelial tip cell formation ( APLN , SOX4 , ITGA5 , PGF , NOTCH4 ) ( Figure 3B , Supplemental Table 4 , and Supplemental Figure 5 ).
